root_cause: Overcharge on PPI Wallet UPI transaction due to incorrect fee calculation against expected rates.
diagnosis: The acquirer charged a fee of Rs 22.30 instead of the expected Rs 18.25 for a PPI Wallet UPI transaction of Rs 2,027.72, resulting in a direct leakage of Rs 4.05.
action_rationale: Requesting an MDR refund is the direct method to recover verified fee overcharges from the acquirer.
